candidates.name: Bakken East Pipeline

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 row 12 (Natural Gas Pipeline Projects): 350 mi, 36 or 42 in, +1000 MMcf/d, Pre-applied, in service 2029; notes cite FERC pre-filing PF26-4
WBI Energy project page loads and names Bakken East

candidates.why_maybe_new: WBI's own competing line to Intensity (P7782/P7783); no GEM row for WBI Bakken East. Roster P3162/P3584-3588 are WBI North Bakken Expansion, a different project. Length 350 mi per EIA (about 563 km); notes also mention a 90-mile Jamestown to Ellendale lateral.

candidates.name: CEGT Line2-AD-24 Childes Lateral

evidence.note: EIA historical sheet row 381: 24 mi, 16/20/24 in, +400 MMcf/d, docket CP05-58, in service Dec 2005 (cost 3.5 million per the workbook cost column)

candidates.why_maybe_new: Operating 2005 lateral of about 24 mi (38.6 km) with no roster row; closest roster entries are generic CEGT/Enable systems (P0161). Length from EIA only; the 24 in diameter value may be confounded with the length field, verify against the CP05-58 order.

candidates.name: CEGT Replacement Project

evidence.note: EIA historical sheet row 492: 25 mi, 24 in, docket CP07-404, in service Mar 2008

candidates.why_maybe_new: 25 mi (40 km) of 24 in pipe in Arkansas, 2008. It replaced existing pipe, so it may be a replacement of existing line rather than new capacity; vetting should decide if GEM tracks it.

candidates.name: CEGT Tontitown Project

evidence.note: EIA historical sheet row 580: 16 mi, 24 in, +132 MMcf/d, docket CP08-69, in service Jan 2009
FERC notice of intent for the Tontitown Project (CenterPoint Energy Gas Transmission)

candidates.why_maybe_new: 16 mi (25.7 km) of 24 in pipe OK to AR, operating 2009; no roster row. Just above the 25 km floor.

candidates.name: Central Mainline Corridor Expansion
aka: Northern Natural Gas Central Mainline Corridor Expansion
candidates.from: Princeton Road power station area, Hallam NE; Omaha; Des Moines

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 row 25: Applied, in service 2027, 535 MMcf/d; notes list 14.64 mi of 30 in, 9 mi of 20 in loop, 2.48 mi of 20 in extension (about 26 mi total)

candidates.why_maybe_new: Total new pipe about 26 mi (42 km) but split into three short segments, each under 25 km. GEM tracks Northern Lights expansions (P2578, P3942) as rows, so this likely gets its own row. Not a match to P2579 main line.

candidates.name: Cimarron Expansion Project
candidates.sponsor: Cimarron River Pipeline, LLC (EIA lists DCP Midstream)

evidence.note: EIA historical sheet row 1148: 48 mi, +631 MMcf/d, docket PF17-7, cancelled Aug 2018, anchor shipper withdrew
FERC notice: about 49.3 mi of new pipe in Beaver Co OK and Seward Co KS plus lease of 19.1 mi of an idle 26 in line

candidates.why_maybe_new: Cancelled expansion of the Cimarron River system (roster P6900 is the operating Cimarron River Gas Pipeline, no length). About 49.3 mi (79 km) new pipe, so it is an expansion row of its own.
